title: Website: new sign-up form to the owner's spec, honest thank-you, privacy page rewrite, /waiting-list/ FAQ page
brief:
CONTEXT. Kirkcaldy Dental & Implant Clinic, 23–25 Tolbooth Street, Kirkcaldy KY1 1RW. This is a pre-opening WAITING LIST campaign. Repo: github.com/fqpmc824wx-droid/Kirkcaldy. The live site pages are on branch claude/brave-allen-i14xnx (PR #1): site/index.html, site/privacy.html, site/register/index.html, site/b/, site/l/. Your own branch claude/hostinger-plugin-install-eyvjb3 (PR #2) holds the halfway deep-gold logo files in site/assets/, and the two merge cleanly. From now on YOU own everything in site/. Make a working branch from claude/brave-allen-i14xnx, merge in PR #2's site/assets/ (but NOT PR #2's old index.html or privacy.html, which have the wrong email), and open a PR into main. The Leaflet chat owns leaflet/apps-script.gs, the form's backend. It is changing that script at the same time: send it the field list below before you push, because both changes must ship together. Wording: follow BRAND.md exactly, say 'waiting list' only, and never use any phrase on BRAND.md's banned list. Don't upload anything to Hostinger, don't paste into Apps Script and don't message real people.

1) /register/ FORM. Owner's decision: name and mobile required, email optional. Use these fields in this order, with these exact name attributes. name = 'Full name' (required). phone = 'Mobile number' (required, type=tel). email = 'Email (optional)'. postcode = 'Postcode (optional)'. people = 'How many people would you like to add?' 1/2/3/4+ (optional). who = 'Who is this for?' Adult/Child/Family (optional). heard = 'How did you hear about us? (optional)', a dropdown: Leaflet, Banner, Facebook, Instagram, Google, Friend or family, Other. DELETE the 'Are you currently registered with a dentist?' question (field `registered`, lines 77–81) and its JS check (line 133). DELETE 'It takes about 30 seconds' (line 60). Keep the hidden honeypot field `website`. REPLACE the required consent box (line 93, and the message on line 134) with two parts. (a) A plain notice, not a tick box: 'By joining, you're asking Kirkcaldy Dental & Implant Clinic to add you to our waiting list. We'll text and call you about your request between 8am and 9pm, and email you to confirm if you give an email address. Joining doesn't register you with the practice yet. We won't send you marketing unless you tick the box below. See our privacy policy.' Link the last words to privacy.html. (b) A separate OPTIONAL, UNTICKED checkbox, name=marketing value=yes: 'Yes, also send me news and offers from Kirkcaldy Dental by text and email. I can opt out at any time.' Make one random ID per page load and send it as `vid` with both the visit ping and the sign-up. Keep `source` from ?src= as now. Removing postcode or the questions later must not break the page.

2) HONEST THANK-YOU. Remove mode:'no-cors' from both fetch calls (lines 118, 143). POST the URLSearchParams body with no custom headers, so it stays a simple request, then read response.text(). Show the thank-you ONLY when the text is exactly 'ok'. On 'missing', say which field is needed. On 'error', any other reply or a network failure, show: 'Sorry, that didn't go through. Please try again, or email your name and mobile number to info@kirkcaldydental.co.uk.' Disable the button while it is sending. Move the /exec URL out of the page into site/assets/config.js (window.KD_ENDPOINT = 'PASTE_APPS_SCRIPT_URL_HERE';). Load it on /register/ and the home page. If it still holds the placeholder, block the submit and show the error text. Write down the setup-night check for the Ads chat's runbook: after pasting the real URL, submit once and confirm the page shows the thank-you, which proves the reply can be read cross-site.

3) THANK-YOU TEXT: 'Thanks – you're on the waiting list. We've sent you a confirmation text (and an email if you gave one). We'll call you between 8am and 9pm to check your details. Joining doesn't register you with the practice yet. Need urgent dental care now? Contact your current dentist, or NHS 24 on 111 out of hours.' Leave a marked HTML comment where the NHS Fife Dental Advice Line goes (01592 226555, weekdays 8:30am–5pm, NOT yet confirmed by NHS Fife).

4) PRIVACY PAGE. Rewrite site/privacy.html. Remove Zapier (line 68). ClickSend 'sends our text messages, including alerts to our staff'. Lawful basis: handling the person's own request to join the waiting list (and legitimate interests for the waiting-list updates); marketing only if they tick the optional box (replace line 60). Say we text and call about the request between 8am and 9pm, and send a confirmation text and email. Use 'waiting-list form' instead of 'registration form' (lines 46, 65, 66). Cover details people give about others in their household, including children. Say callers ask where their current dentist is and whether they're in pain or have swelling, so they can be sent to urgent care. Ask the owner whether to treat that as health data, and stop line 49 saying 'We do not ask for medical information'. Cover the transfers to ClickSend (Australia) and Meta (USA) and their safeguards. State retention periods, and say that nothing is deleted automatically yet. Fix line 81: visits now carry a random visit ID that can be linked to a sign-up. Add a section with id='delete-your-data' explaining how to delete your data (Meta needs this URL). Add a data-protection complaints route to the clinic (acknowledged within 30 days), then the ICO (line 78). Show visible TODO markers, and do NOT invent values, for: [OWNER: legal company name, company number, registered office], [OWNER: ICO registration number], [OWNER: phone number], [OWNER: NHS / mixed / private].

5) NEW PAGE site/waiting-list/index.html (the Facebook form's completion button goes to /waiting-list/?src=fb-form-done and can't be changed later). Same visit ping as /register/. Cover: what joining means (not registration, free to join, no obligation); how invitations work ([OWNER: the order rule they sign], households kept together); 'We never ask for payment, bank details or ID to join'; no walk-in sign-ups; how to leave the list (email info@kirkcaldydental.co.uk or tell the caller); urgent care (your dentist, NHS 24 on 111, Fife line once confirmed); that the practice will offer NHS and private care [OWNER confirm]; a link to the privacy page; a button to /register/.

6) BRAND on home, register, privacy and waiting-list: BRAND.md fonts (Playfair Display + Inter) and colours (cream #F6F2EA, deep gold #8A6A2C, charcoal #30363B) instead of Cormorant/Lato/#c3a363. Use the halfway logo from PR #2. Add the visit ping to the home page with source 'home'. Footer on every page: '© 2026 [OWNER: legal company name]', 'Website last updated: <month year>', and hidden placeholders for the phone number and the NHS/mixed line.

7) TEST at 375px width: no sideways scroll; submitting with email blank sends no email and waits for 'ok'; a fake 'error' reply shows the fallback text; the placeholder URL blocks the submit.

DONE WHEN: the PR into main is open, the field list has been sent to the Leaflet chat, and a short list of owner facts still needed is ready for the owner. THEN, after the owner merges and says all fixes are done: build kirkcaldy-dental-website.zip from site/ on main, upload it to Drive 'Kirkcaldy Dental – Print files & marketing' → '5. Website', and bin the two old zips there ('kirkcaldy-dental-website.zip' 21:12 and 'Website files (upload to Hostinger).zip' 11:52). Tell the Ads chat the file name for runbook §1. Leave folder 5 holding only the zip and a one-line READ ME.

title: Facebook lead script fixes + App Review pack + launch-day fallback + checklists
brief:
CONTEXT. leads/meta-leads.gs and leads/meta-ads.gs on claude/determined-heisenberg-d02bac. Don't paste into the live Apps Script.
1) Consent (line 247): stop treating 'any ticked box' as marketing consent. Match the specific marketing checkbox by its key or text ('news and offers'), defaulting to No. Add two Facebook rows to runbook Step 6 (ticked gives Yes, unticked gives No). Meta's docs say checkbox answers aren't in field_data (developers.facebook.com/docs/marketing-api/guides/lead-ads/retrieving). Confirm with the first test lead that the bulk /leads call returns custom_disclaimer_responses. If it doesn't, fetch each lead by ID.
2) Rate limit: Meta allows about 200 × 24 × (leads in the last 90 days) calls per Page, so a new Page gets almost nothing. On a rate-limit error (codes 4/17/32/613 or the message), set POLL_PAUSE_UNTIL 10 minutes ahead, skip polls until then (stretching to at most 1 hour) and email once. Runbook: keep the last test lead in Meta until real leads arrive.
3) handleLead (lines 276–277): put SMS status and Email status into `values` before appendRow, as doPost does, and drop getLastRow(). The website script can save without the lock after 20s.
4) With the Leaflet chat (identical alertTeam): at 8am, split the 'Call 8am' rows round-robin between callers on shift, fill 'Assigned to' and text each caller their own count. Mark who is on shift (a 'Rota' tab or ONCALL_MOBILE per shift) so 'rotate' skips people who are off. meta-ads.gs line 261 (the add-a-caller alarm) should count only callers on shift.
5) CLOSED_DAYS property (yyyy-mm-dd list) in both scripts and tracking.gs: no caller alerts, 8am summary or retry reminders on those days, and leadText names the next open day instead of 'from 8am'.
6) A do-not-contact list tab (last 10 digits of phone, email, date) checked by both scripts, so a deleted row never forgets a stop request.
7) leads/health.gs and the monitors, per research/premortem-final.md §3. The website script already calls healthMark, healthAssertSheet and healthAlert behind typeof guards.
8) Code-review the Leaflet chat's tracking.gs (2441aab) and apps-script.gs 5971c5d. Both landed after every review.
9) App Review pack (a Google Doc in Drive '9. Legal & compliance'): use-case text for each permission (leads_retrieval, pages_manage_ads, pages_read_engagement, pages_show_list, pages_manage_metadata, business_management, ads_read), a screencast script showing a test lead reaching the sheet, and test steps. Plus a LAUNCH-DAY FALLBACK card in case the API can't read leads: Business Suite Leads notifications on the caller's phone; Leads Center download every hour, pasted into the sheet with Source 'facebook'; the confirmation text sent by hand only as the approved service text; ads cut to £5/day until fixed.
10) Short checklists for the owner's Drive: 'Adding a caller' (training done, own Google login, work phone, rota, ONCALL_MOBILE, ALERT_MODE rotate, BACKLOG_ALERT 15, Ads Manager leads rule 25 × callers); a weekly mystery-shopper test (one ad-form and one leaflet-QR sign-up from a phone with no Page role; check the text, email, row, call within the hour, call logged); a surge plan (standby callers, 'sign-ups paused' wording for the form, website and Page, a press holding statement, when to raise SMS_DAILY_MAX).
11) With the Metrics chat: a one-page owner card ('every day 5 min', 'every Monday 15 min', 'if this email arrives, do this' for each alarm: texts failing, credit low, ad rejected, cost per lead over £3.50, leads missing, backlog, Meta API 190).

title: NHS Fife email + compliance pack drafts
brief:
CONTEXT. The owner is non-technical. Write in short, plain sentences and mark everything 'Draft – not legal advice, owner to approve'. Create a Drive folder '9. Legal & compliance' (private, info@ only) under 'Kirkcaldy Dental – Print files & marketing' and put these Google Docs in it. Wording rules: BRAND.md, 'waiting list' only.
1) An email for the owner to send to NHS Fife's dental/primary care team, asking: (1) for a letter confirming the dentists are on, or provisionally on, the NHS Fife dental list for 23–25 Tolbooth Street, and whether the company must be listed and when the inspection is; (2) whether a pre-opening waiting list may be advertised, and with what wording; (3) whether children or families may be invited first; (4) which urgent-care number our messages should give (confirm the Dental Advice Line 01592 226555, weekdays 8:30am–5pm); (5) whether they will tell the Fife Dental Advice Line (fife.dentaladviceline@nhs.scot) about the list and how to describe us; (6) the SDAI questions from research/waitlist-playbook.md §9.

7) A draft email to Fife Council planning (and a note for the landlord) about a temporary banner on the railings of 23–25 Tolbooth Street, a Category B listed building (Historic Environment Scotland LB36372): is listed building consent and/or advertisement consent needed? Also confirm who owns the railings. Fix with cable ties only.

title: Staff guide fixes in Drive folder 8 (caller script, templates, training, replies)
brief:
CONTEXT. Your drafts are in Drive 'Kirkcaldy Dental – Print files & marketing' → '8. Waiting list – staff guide' (folder ID 1wYbqGbks8VquOwQbYOuFf9ZBdpgLOwfq): '1. Caller script', '2. Message templates' (TWO copies: 1-808mlKgs7… 21:58:06 and 1CspWkeFWe… 21:58:46), '3. Comment and DM replies', '4. Invitation plan' (TWO copies: 1wrmA3VVL… 21:58:10 and 182z0vtN8… 21:58:49) and '5. Owner decisions needed'. BRAND.md names a branch claude/waitlist-playbook for you, but it doesn't exist, so Drive is your home. Keep every doc marked 'Draft – owner to approve'. Wording: BRAND.md, 'waiting list' only, no banned phrases.
1) Compare each duplicate pair, keep the more complete one and bin the other.
2) The caller script must match the call-tracking code (leaflet/tracking.gs on claude/brave-allen-i14xnx). Callers PICK the Call outcome (column Y) from exactly: No answer, Voicemail, Busy/declined, Reached - booked, Reached - call back, Reached - on list, Reached - not interested, Found another dentist – leave list (the Leaflet chat is renaming 'Already has dentist'), Wrong number, Withdrew, DO NOT CONTACT. The script then sets Status, the attempt count, Next call due and Call history. Free-text notes go in Notes, never in Call outcome: tracking.gs ignores any value not on the list, so nothing is logged. Don't tell callers to overwrite Status. Before opening, use 'Reached - on list' rather than 'booked'. Get the final list from the Leaflet chat.
3) People still registered elsewhere who want to join stay on the list: write their practice in 'Current practice'. Use 'Found another dentist – leave list' only if they want to come off.
4) Email is now optional on both forms: in step 2, ask for an email only if they'd like updates by email. Don't promise a confirmation email.
5) Pain route: fill in 'NHS Fife Dental Advice Line 01592 226555, weekdays 8:30am–5pm' with 'confirm with NHS Fife before use'. Keep 111 and 999 as they are.
6) Household names and ages and the pain question are personal (and possibly health) details. Tell the Website chat so the privacy page covers them. Callers note only what's needed (e.g. 'Pain – signposted 111 [date]'), with no clinical detail.
7) New drafts: (a) a caller training pack for a 30–45 minute session (the script, practice calls, logging a call on the phone, data rules: delete alert texts after calling, no screenshots or WhatsApp forwarding, screen lock on, what to do if a phone is lost, breaches reported within 72 hours); (b) a one-page caller confidentiality note to sign; (c) a 'difficult calls' rule (abuse: end politely and tell the manager; severe pain or swelling affecting breathing or swallowing: 999/111; a child or vulnerable adult answers; scam worries; who handles complaints); (d) a one-page reception briefing for the owner's other practices (Glenrothes Dental House, Kingdom Dental Glenrothes, Leven, Cupar): what to say, no promises, and moving practice ends the old registration only at the first appointment.
8) Message templates: the first 3-weekly update (due about 1 Dec): facts only, no offers, prices or links to the other practices. Also 'our opening date has moved' and 'do you still want your place?' (after 6–8 weeks). Opt-out is by email or phone, because the 'KirkDental' sender can't receive replies.
9) Comment/DM replies: check them against the banned phrases. Add an out-of-hours auto-reply, who covers evenings and weekends, and escalation (complaints, press, NHS Fife, anyone in pain).
10) Update '5. Owner decisions needed' to match the owner decision list in this plan.
DONE WHEN: folder 8 holds only the current numbered docs (duplicates binned) and you have a one-line note to the owner on what to read and approve.
